acceptance.given: The public entry declaration and invocation boundary are available, and required caller setup has not been established.

oracle.expected: A structural declaration check identifies every required caller setup, and invocation without required setup fails during preflight before proceeding.
forbidden: The entry succeeds only because undeclared caller setup was performed.
Required caller setup is hidden from the declaration.
Only a runtime return value is checked without inspecting declaration or preflight behavior.
oracle.observable: Declaration metadata and preflight trace expose all caller setup requirements and show fail-before-proceed behavior when setup is absent.

acceptance.then: The public entry is self-contained with respect to declared caller setup, or rejects invocation before proceeding when required setup is absent.
acceptance.when: Run the existing skill contract validator test that checks public-entry declarations and preflight behavior with required caller setup omitted; evaluate declaration coverage and the preflight outcome.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select scripts/sc/tests/test_validate_skill_contract.py::test_package_is_valid as the existing package-contract validation entry; use it to expose an undeclared caller-setup dependency or missing preflight rejection. Do not target the absent scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a10 selector.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate that public entries declare all caller setup required by their preflight and reject invocation when undeclared required setup is missing.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; rollback restores the prior public-entry contract validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Public entry invocation moves from potentially relying on undeclared caller setup to either declared self-contained setup or deterministic preflight rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted validator test verifies declaration coverage and preflight rejection for omitted required setup, with no undeclared setup dependency accepted.
